name: IC Analog — 20V — SO
description: Analog IC cluster containing 20V surface-mount components in SO-14 packages with 1.27mm pitch, including CD4066BM and CD4066BNS.
selection_hints: Select based on required package dimensions: SO-14 3.9x8.65mm (CD4066BM) or SO-14 5.3x10.2mm (CD4066BNS).
Prefer Tier A component CD4066BM over Tier B component CD4066BNS.
Ensure compatibility with 1.27mm pitch SMD land patterns.
avoid_when: Through-hole or non-SMD mounting is required.
The PCB design requires footprint packages other than SO-14.
Voltage requirements differ from the specified 20V rating.
